name: San Pedro de Atacama
tagline: Desert lagoons, geysers and the clearest skies
summary: San Pedro de Atacama is an adobe oasis in the world's driest desert. Watch sunset in the Valley of the Moon, rise before dawn for the El Tatio geysers, float in the salty Laguna Cejar, see flamingos at the altiplanic lagoons and join a world-class stargazing tour.
seasonNote: Sunny year-round; nights are freezing in winter and summer can bring 'altiplanic' rain.
arrival: Fly to Calama, then 1.5 hours by shuttle.
gettingAround: Tours or a rented car; bikes for nearby valleys.
cashTip: Cards are common; carry pesos for buses, small shops and park fees in remote areas.
foodTip: Altiplano dishes with quinoa and llama.
